messages:
Nina (Account Exec): starting the Cypherlane identity preflight. They require SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (users + groups), and RBAC mapped to Okta groups. POC window = 10 business days. Need SE/security/legal greenlight.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): quick clarifying pts: 1) Do they expect group nesting? 2) Expected users ~12k, groups ~150, peak sync windows? 3) Any custom SCIM attrs (employeeType, costCenter)?
Nina (Account Exec): they may use nested groups for partners. peak import could be a full bulk + daily deltas. custom attr: employeeType and isContractor.
Lena (Security Eng): checklist: EU data residency? BYOK? provable deletion SLA? screening on subprocessors. Also ask for their retention/ERASURE policy for GDPR mapping.
Marcel (Product): technical notes: nested groups supported but can cause O(N^2) membership expansion on naive delta. recommend Dedicated for deterministic SCIM throughput during initial import. Also we have a group-deduping toggle to avoid membership storms.
Tom (Legal): we'll need a signed DPA if EU residency required. share their standard security questionnaire - legal will review subprocessors.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): sample SCIM bulk create we plan to use (POST):
```json
POST /scim/v2/Users
[
  {"userName":"alice@cypherlane.com","externalId":"u-123","schemas":[],"meta":{}},
  {"userName":"bob@cypherlane.com","externalId":"u-124"}
]
```
Arjun (Solutions Eng): and sample SAML attribute mapping: send `eduPersonScopedAffiliation` -> role, but primary mapping will be Okta groups.
Lena (Security Eng): confirm: do we perform any PII redaction in logs (email/user ids)? we redact tokens but keep hashed ids in traces. Need to list in questionnaire.
Nina (Account Exec): customer wants full audit trail for role changes and SCIM actions for 90 days. Is that ok?
Marcel (Product): Console supports audit events retention tiers; 90 days default for Hosted, 365 available as add-on. For POC we can enable 90-day retention in staging.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): ops-runbook outline: 1) customer spins scoped Okta admin app with SCIM write 2) we'll run a dry run (no writes) to report deltas 3) run full import in staging org 4) validate RBAC via two sample apps (app-a, app-b) using SAML role assertions 5) teardown and provable deletion.
deploy-bot: staging org ready: rwd-stg-cypherlane-2, created=1766241155, region=eu-west-1
Arjun (Solutions Eng): note on domain control: if they use multiple subdomains, we can scope tenants by verified domains. need their domain proofing plan (DNS TXT or email).
Lena (Security Eng): security blocker: BYOK requested for encryption-at-rest keys. BYOK for Private is supported; Hosted requires a KMS add-on with additional compliance review. flagging for SRE.
Nina (Account Exec): pricing ask: please give three quote lines: 1) Hosted baseline (SCIM throttles) 2) Dedicated commit for predictable sync 3) Private with BYOK + extended retention. Samir - can you provide numbers? (pinging Marcel)
Marcel (Product): will prepare high-level IO for each tier. Important: if they request <5s group syncs, that's a custom throughput SLA and adds ~$ per month.
Tom (Legal): also require subprocessors list and most recent SOC2 report before we ingest production data. We'll accept for POC staging once SOC2 link provided.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): POC acceptance criteria proposal: - successful full SCIM import of 12k users + 150 groups, no >1% error rate - group membership change propagation within 60s for typical changes - RBAC enforced on sample apps for three roles - staging teardown with provable deletion report.
Nina (Account Exec): I'll request Okta svc creds scoped to SCIM writes and an admin invite for SAML app testing. Will share via 1Password.
Lena (Security Eng): send the security questionnaire answers back ASAP. I'll review and note any hard blockers.
Marcel (Product): one more ops detail: if SCIM returns 429, we'll backoff with exponential retry and surface per-request metrics in Console. Document this in the runbook.
Nina (Account Exec): thanks team. I'll compile quote + ask customer for SOC2 link and Okta scoped creds. target: run dry run in 48 hours. :calendar:
